<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex087032026-06-1504-23-46" status="reviewed"> 
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3809">kha cig</rs> <note type="gloss"><choice><reg><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3809">khyung</rs></reg><orig>(khy)ung</orig></choice></note> na re bsgrub bya'i chos dang tshogs don la rtags yod pa yang yod mod kyi <expan>thams cad</expan> du de dag rtags kyi yod gzhir ma nges shing mi dgos pas de dag la yod par mi go la | mthun dpe' chos can ni rnam pa <expan>thams cad</expan> du rtags kyi yod gzhir nges pas de la go dgos yod do || 
         <mentioned>'o na bsgrub bya'i chos dang tshogs don kyang rtags kyi yod gzhir nges pas de dag la yod pa la yang go dgos yod do zhe na | </mentioned>
         de dag <expan>thams cad</expan> du rtags kyi yod gzhir nges <lb n="33b8"/> na bsgrub chos dor bas stong nyid med dgag du bsgrub pa 'am tshul gsuM tshang pas byas pa gtan tshigs su bsgrub pa'i skabs su yang bsgrub bya'i chos dang tshogs don la gtan tshigs de dag yod par 'gyur ro || <mentioned>mthun dpe' yang thams cad du rtags kyi yod gzhir nges na de dag gi skabs su mthun dpe' buM med dang du ba lasogs pa la gtan tshigs de dag yod par thal lo zhe na</mentioned> 
         de ni 'dod pas nyid pas mtshungs pa ma yin no zhes zer ro ||</seg></TEI>
